description: Integrity rules for rights and shares: arithmetic, separation of composition and master rights and the approval required for any change. Consumers: rights-operations-agent, shares-operations-agent, rights-integrity-agent, credits-operations-agent and the validate-*-shares and rights skills.

arithmetic.total: each right type totals exactly one hundred percent

origin: every right traces to a contract, assignment or declaration; rights without an origin are reported
separation: composition rights and shares live on the Work and master rights and shares on the Phonogram; neither is inferred from the other
mergeSafety: share totals and rights per Work and Phonogram are identical before and after a merge, with a pre-merge snapshot kept
